goal: Allow users to send transactions to BIP 352 Silent Payment addresses directly from Bitcoin Core
Support fee-bumping for Silent Payment transactions via RBF to prevent stuck payments and address reuse
reviewability: Review is worthwhile now as nothing known invalidates the diff
agreement: Blocked by an unaddressed objection on MSVC compilation failing in walletmodel.cpp (Yudis-bit)
Contested objections regarding leaf key derivation and metadata loss after RBF fee bumps (Yudis-bit)
Dropped objection on wallet downgrade flags in favor of proposing a placeholder txid (rustaceanrob)
Concept approval without stated reasons (rkrux, rustaceanrob, w0xlt)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it adds the scantxforsilentpayments RPC to scan transactions for BIP 352 outputs
It provides programmatic output inspection and testing utilities rather than core user flows

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it enables wallet spending and coin selection to pay Silent Payment recipients
Users gain substantial privacy benefits and avoid on-chain address reuse
